text: {"features":[{"name":"Production engineering experience","description":"Shows the depth of hands-on work testing, maintaining, and launching production software systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents only near-minimum experience, such as a few years and a narrow record of just a couple production services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Presents early-career depth, with either limited time across several services or longer time across only a small number of systems."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents solid mid-level depth, showing multiple years and repeated work across production testing, maintenance, and launches."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents strong depth, with sustained responsibility across several production services over a substantial span of time."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents extensive, clearly role-ready depth, combining long tenure with repeated ownership across many production services."}]},{"name":"Go systems depth","description":"Shows how central and substantive the applicant's Go experience is for relevant back-end or infrastructure work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only briefly or as one language among many, without showing meaningful systems ownership in it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Identifies Go as a common working language but gives little detail about what was built with it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes clear that Go is a main language and connects it to real service or infrastructure work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong Go ownership through design or implementation of back-end systems relevant to internal tooling or security infrastructure."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Portrays Go as the core language behind significant, role-aligned back-end systems with clear architectural responsibility."}]},{"name":"Python engineering depth","description":"Shows the depth of Python use for production services, automation, analysis, or tooling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or mentions it too vaguely to show usable depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python as a secondary or scripting language without clear production responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for automation, tooling, prototypes, or internal services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production Python experience, such as building services or robust tooling that other engineers rely on."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a deeply used engineering language with clear ownership of production services, automation, and tooling central to the role."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic problem-solving","description":"Shows practical command of data structures and algorithms through concrete engineering problems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of algorithmic or data-structure skill."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength only generally or with a light example that lacks scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one concrete example of improving a system through better algorithm or data-structure choice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong practical command through a substantial redesign or important hot-path improvement."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic thinking a clear differentiator, supported by sophisticated examples and clear technical confidence."}]},{"name":"AI systems experience","description":"Shows direct experience building or operating AI-enabled features relevant to production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of AI or ML work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in AI or agents without concrete shipped work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows direct work on AI or LLM-backed features but with limited detail on production use."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI experience and mentions evaluation, reliability, trust, or guardrails."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep production AI experience by combining shipped model-backed functionality with explicit evaluation or reliability practices."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"Shows experience designing systems that use agents under bounded, observable control.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of agentic-system design or implementation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents only aspirationally or without clear build responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows direct experience building agentic tooling but gives limited architectural detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of agentic systems, including clear separation between agents and controlling services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows sophisticated agentic design, clearly describing bounded actions, permissions, auditability, or guardrails around agents."}]},{"name":"Security assessment practice","description":"Shows hands-on experience identifying, documenting, and following through on security risks in software systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of conducting security assessments or reviews."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals security interest or credentials but no clear hands-on assessment work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some direct assessment experience, such as security reviews of services or basic threat modeling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows solid assessment practice, including structured reviews, attack-surface analysis, or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong assessment depth through formal or repeated reviews, documented findings, and follow-through to remediation."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"Shows direct work automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, variant analysis, or related security-response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of work on vulnerability handling or response automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in vulnerability response or toil reduction but no concrete automation example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some hands-on involvement in automating vulnerability handling, but with limited scope or detail."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear ownership of tooling that triages, classifies, routes, or deduplicates vulnerability reports and reduces manual work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong, role-aligned ownership of vulnerability-response automation with clear workflow design and concrete operational impact."}]},{"name":"Platform leverage orientation","description":"Shows motivation for central infrastructure work that improves security outcomes across many teams rather than one product.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Frames the role mostly as a generic engineering job, with little sign of interest in broad organizational leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some interest in security impact but says little about central tooling or multi-team reach."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Recognizes that the work affects many teams and values organization-wide impact in general terms."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly values foundational systems and explains why central infrastructure creates outsized security leverage."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes platform-level leverage a core theme, showing a mature understanding of how central tooling compounds across an organization."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement orientation","description":"Shows understanding that strong security tooling should make the secure path easier for product engineers.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says little about serving other engineers or frames security mostly as inspection or enforcement."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at helping others but does not clearly describe security as an enablement function."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some concern for reducing friction or making secure practice easier for developers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly frames security as enabling builders through good tooling, defaults, or close partnership."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Offers a nuanced enablement view, explicitly emphasizing secure defaults, low-friction workflows, and empathy for busy developers."}]},{"name":"Role tailoring","description":"Shows how specifically the letter connects the applicant's background to this exact Google Information Security Engineering role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Could plausibly be sent to many general backend or security roles with little change."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions the job title or one posted keyword but remains mostly generic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Aligns the background to a few relevant elements of the posting, such as security tooling, Go, Python, or AI agents."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly ties experience to several posted responsibilities or qualifications, showing clear targeting to the role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Feels precisely written for this role, weaving together the team's mission, technical stack, and core responsibilities throughout the letter."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"Shows how concretely the letter backs claims with examples, scope, architecture, or outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims of skill or fit without concrete supporting detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few examples, but they remain generic, unscoped, or outcome-free."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides several concrete examples of work, though the impact or technical detail is only partly developed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Supports major claims with specific projects, technical choices, or outcomes that make the experience easy to picture."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Repeatedly substantiates claims with vivid, credible detail about systems built, problems solved, and results achieved."}]},{"name":"External security signals","description":"Shows independent evidence of security seriousness through certifications, offensive practice, or other external signals.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no independent security signal beyond day-job claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Offers a light signal, such as a basic certification or a brief mention of occasional practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Offers a moderate signal, such as recurring CTF participation or one meaningful but not elite credential."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Offers a strong signal, such as an OSCP-level practical credential or sustained high-level offensive practice."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Offers exceptional independent credibility through a strong practical credential combined with sustained offensive practice or similarly high-signal validation."}]},{"name":"Self-directed initiative","description":"Shows technical initiative beyond assigned job duties through open-source work, upstream fixes, or self-driven projects.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of meaningful technical work outside normal job responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small side project or occasional extra effort with limited scope or continuity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows consistent initiative through modest maintenance, upstream fixes, or a small but sustained personal build."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong initiative through an actively maintained open-source project or a substantial self-driven systems project."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows standout initiative through sustained ownership of technically ambitious or widely used work beyond the day job."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"Measures spelling, grammar, and sentence-level polish.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent mechanical errors that repeatedly distract from the content or undermine professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains numerous noticeable errors that interrupt flow even though the meaning remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Contains some errors, but they are intermittent rather than constant and do not obscure the overall message."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is mostly clean, with only minor slips that do not materially affect professionalism."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is clean and polished, with essentially no distracting mechanical errors."}]},{"name":"Persuasive voice","description":"Measures how memorable, coherent, and compelling the letter feels as a personal case for candidacy.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as flat or purely transactional, with little individuality or persuasive momentum."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some personal framing but mostly feels formulaic or list-driven."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a clear professional tone and some engaging phrasing, though the overall case remains conventional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is consistently engaging, with a coherent voice that makes the applicant's case easy to remember."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is highly compelling, using a distinctive opening and sustained narrative voice to make the applicant feel memorable and well matched."}]}]}
